body.name: Consent for collecting and managing data obtained
body.description: A lawful basis for processing is established and recorded.
body.detail: Data here is obtained under lawful authority, not consent.
observations: CDR/IPDR, banking and social records reach an investigation via legal process. Consent is the wrong lawful basis, and claiming it would misdescribe the deployment.
The control that actually applies is authorisation and audit — see CTL-MON-002.
